item.title: Caution over Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Powers Sparks Backlash from Pro-Jeong Cheong-rae Faction: “Don’t Be Fooled” (보완수사권 폐지 신중론에…친청계 “속지 말라” 거센 반발)
item.description:
As cautious voices within the Democratic Party of Korea emerge regarding the abolition of the prosecution’s supplementary investigation powers, strong opposition is intensifying, particularly from the pro-Jeong Cheong-rae faction. Amid ongoing internal conflicts over whether to maintain or abolish these powers, subtle shifts in the atmosphere are also being detected. (더불어민주당 내에서 검찰 보완수사권 폐지에 대한 신중론이 고개를 들자 친청(정청래)계를 중심으로 거센 반발이 이어지고 있다. 보완수사권 존폐를 둘러싼 내부 갈등이 이어지는 가운데 미묘한 분위기 변화도 감지된다.)

Senior Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok wrote on Facebook on the 15th, “Recently, there have been moves within the party to blur the purpose of abolishing supplementary investigation powers or effectively retreat from it,” adding, “If we allow (prosecution reform) to be shaken or derailed again by conflicting interests and arguments within the party, the Democratic Party will bear a heavy responsibility before history.” Former Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yun also stated, “We must absolutely not be fooled,” and “Whether it’s ‘supplementation,’ ‘reduction,’ or ‘alternatives,’ leaving any investigative powers to the prosecution means failure of prosecution reform.” At the general meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers held the previous day, Rep. Hong Gi-won, who proposed a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that exceptionally allows the prosecution direct supplementary investigation powers, along with nine others, publicly stated that “a cautious approach is needed toward the full abolition of supplementary investigation powers.” Rep. Choi Min-hee responded by writing, “Yesterday at the general meeting, I listened carefully to the statements by Reps. Hong Gi-won, Park Gyun-taek, and Ko Min-jung,” and “In my judgment, Rep. Hong Gi-won’s proposed bill was one that perpetuates the prosecution’s investigative powers.” (문정복 최고위원은 15일 페이스북에 “최근 당내 일각에서 보완수사권 폐지의 취지를 흐리거나 사실상 후퇴시키려는 움직임이 보인다”며 “(검찰개혁을) 당내의 엇갈린 이해와 주장으로 다시 흔들거나 좌초시킨다면, 민주당은 역사 앞에 큰 책임을 지게 될 것”이라고 적었다. 이성윤 전 최고위원도 “절대 속아서는 안 된다”며 “‘보완’ ‘축소’ ‘대안’이든 무엇이든 검찰의 수사권을 남겨두는 것은 검찰개혁의 실패”라고 했다. 전날 열린 민주당 의원총회에서는 예외적으로 검찰의 직접 보완수사권을 허용하는 내용의 형사소송법 개정안을 발의한 홍기원 의원 등 10명이 ‘보완수사권 전면 폐지에 신중해야 한다’고 공개 발언했다. 최민희 의원은 이에 대해 “어제 의총에서 홍기원·박균택·고민정 의원 등의 발언을 경청했다”며 “제 판단엔 홍기원 의원 대표발의 법안은 검찰 수사권 존치법안이었다”고 썼다.)

The previous day, former leader Jeong Cheong-rae shared an article reflecting the atmosphere of that general meeting, writing, “Why has the mood suddenly become like this… It’s depressing.” The post was met with comments listing the names and constituencies of lawmakers who signed onto Rep. Hong Gi-won’s bill. Pressure-filled comments also followed, such as “Let’s launch a campaign to vote them out” and “Let’s eliminate them all in the candidate nominations.” A lawmaker who participated in proposing the bill told The Hankyoreh, “Many attacking comments were posted on Facebook, and I’ve been receiving a lot of text messages raising issues with the bill since yesterday,” and added, “It feels like they’re targeting us.” Pro-caution Rep. Kim Nam-hee, speaking on SBS Radio that day, pointed out, “Some lawmakers are trying to use supplementary investigation powers as a political tool,” and “They are using the abolition of supplementary investigation powers as a tool to appeal to hardline party members, which is inappropriate conduct for a politician.” (전날 정청래 전 대표가 이런 의총 분위기가 담긴 기사를 공유하고 “갑자기 왜 이런 분위기가 됐는지…우울합니다”라고 적은 글에는 홍기원 의원 안에 서명한 의원들의 이름과 지역구가 적힌 댓글이 달렸다. 이들을 향해 ‘낙선 운동을 벌이자’ ‘공천 때 다 날리자’ 같은 압박성 댓글도 따라붙었다. 법안 발의에 참여한 한 의원은 한겨레에 “페이스북에 공격하는 댓글이 많이 달렸고, 어제부터 (법안에 대한 문제 제기) 문자를 많이 받고 있다”며 “좌표를 찍는 것이 아닌가”라고 말했다. 신중론 쪽에 선 김남희 의원은 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오에서 “보완수사권을 일종의 정치적 도구로 활용하려는 의원들도 있다”며 “보완수사권 폐지를 강성 당원들에게 소구하고자 하는 도구로 이용하는데, 정치인으로서 부적절한 행위”라고 지적했다.)

Amid the party’s once-dominant opinion favoring the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers, cautious voices are gradually emerging. Five-term lawmaker Park Ji-won, appearing on YTN Radio’s “Jang Seong-cheol’s News Myeongdang” that day, said, “In the case of Jang Yun-gi, issues related to the investigation of crimes against the socially vulnerable, youth, women’s sexual crimes, and crimes against the disabled have come to the fore. It is right to retain supplementary investigation powers for such crimes,” adding, “So I too have revised my stance (from full abolition to partial retention).” When asked by the host whether “the majority sentiment within the party is leaning toward the view that an exceptional provision recognizing supplementary investigation powers should be included,” Rep. Park responded, “I believe it’s leaning that way.” (보완수사권 완전 폐지 의견이 지배적이던 당내 분위기 속 신중론은 서서히 고개를 들고 있다. 5선 박지원 의원은 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “장윤기 사건으로 (보완수사권 폐지 때) 사회적 약자, 청소년, 여성 성범죄, 장애인 범죄(수사 문제)가 부각된다. 이런 범죄에 대해서는 보완수사권을 갖는 것이 옳다”며 “그래서 저도 (완전 폐지 의견을 일부 존치로) 수정했다”고 말했다. 박 의원은 ‘예외적으로 보완수사권을 인정하는 조항을 둬야 한다는 쪽으로 당내 다수의 분위기가 잡혀가고 있냐’는 진행자 물음에 “그렇게 잡혀간다고 본다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party held both the first subcommittee and the full session of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee that day to discuss revisions to the Criminal Procedure Act. Minister of Justice Jeong Seong-ho attended the full session and stated, “It is important to ensure that not even 1% of victims suffer injustice,” adding, “Please create a system with such detail that victims’ rights can be guaranteed to the greatest extent possible.” (민주당은 이날 국회 법제사법위원회 1소위원회와 전체회의를 각각 열고 형사소송법 개정안을 논의했다. 정성호 법무부 장관은 전체회의에 출석해 “억울한 1%의 피해자가 없도록 하는 게 중요하다”며 “피해자의 권리가 최대한 보장될 수 있도록 세밀하게 제도를 만들어달라”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Convention Approaches, Disagreements over Merger with Innovation Party… Kim Min-seok ‘Hesitant’, Jeong Cheong-rae ‘Positive’ (민주 전대 앞, 혁신당 합당 이견…김민석 ‘유보’ 정청래 ‘긍정’)
item.description:
Major candidates for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea ahead of its August 17 convention are showing differences in opinion on the direction and method of a merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party. Attention is being paid to whether the issue of merging with the Innovation Party, which sharply divides party opinions, will become a key point of contention at the convention. (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 유력 당대표 후보들이 조국혁신당과의 합당 방향과 방식을 두고 견해차를 보이고 있다. 당내 의견이 뚜렷이 갈리는 혁신당과의 합당 의제가 전당대회의 쟁점으로 떠오를지 주목된다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok announced the ‘Democratic Party’s Four Major Innovation Plans’ at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 15th, listing ‘pursuing a winning grand unity’ as one of them and presenting three principles for merging with the Innovation Party. He stated, “If approval from Democratic Party members, approval from Innovation Party members, and maintaining the Democratic Party’s name and identity—all three conditions are met, then a merger is possible,” but added, “If even one of these conditions is not met, then we can cooperate instead.” While not denying the necessity of a merger itself, he signaled a reluctance to prioritize it by setting the condition of ‘maintaining the party name and identity.’ <<> In contrast, former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae expressed a stance of quickly beginning discussions on a merger if elected party leader. During his candidacy declaration on the 13th, he said, “I regret not being able to hold a vote of all party members (when proposing a merger in January),” and added, “If I become party leader, I will ask for opinions on the merger through a vote of all party members.” <<> Lawmaker Song Young-gil is opposed to a merger. In an interview with YTN Radio’s ‘News Face-off with Lee Dong-hyung’ on the 13th, he stated, “I oppose a merger right now,” and noted, “When the general election comes, we can decide whether to merge based on the situation, but then I think we can form an electoral alliance.” <<>
The differing ‘temperatures’ among former PM Kim, former Representative Jeong, and Lawmaker Song regarding a merger with the Innovation Party stem from the different party member bases they are trying to appeal to. Former Representative Jeong is focusing on rallying the traditional Democratic Party support base, which is favorable to a merger. In contrast, former PM Kim and Lawmaker Song are emphasizing expanding the party’s outreach. <<> Amid this, the rival Innovation Party is not hiding its discomfort. Representative Shin Jang-sik, the sole candidate for party leadership in the Innovation Party’s July 25 convention, wrote on Facebook the previous day, “I hope they would show basic respect and courtesy toward our party,” adding, “I will focus on self-strengthening first. I think it’s premature to talk about a merger right now.”
<<> Meanwhile, in an interview on MBC Radio’s ‘Kim Jong-bae’s Focus’ on the same day, Lawmaker Song criticized former Representative Jeong for saying the previous day that the Democratic Party should have not fielded a candidate in the by-election for the Pyeongtaek Gap National Assembly seat, where Fatherland Innovation Party leader Cho Kook is running. Song said, “That’s extremely irresponsible. It’s like saying to your own son, ‘I should have aborted you (instead of giving birth to you)—it’s the same thing.” Even when the host pointed out, “That analogy is a bit off,” Song continued, “It’s just the same.” Song also remarked, “It feels like (former Representative Jeong) is somewhat looking down on the president.” In response, pro-Jeong lawmaker Choe Min-hee criticized Song on Facebook, saying, “Candidate Song Young-gil, after going on about ‘stalker,’ ‘traitor,’ ‘cut off the head,’ ‘suppression,’ now he’s going on about ‘abortion.’” <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 김민석 전 국무총리는 15일 서울 여의도 민주당 중앙당사에서 ‘민주당 4대 혁신안’을 발표하고, 그 가운데 하나로 “이기는 대통합 추진”을 꼽으며 혁신당과의 ‘합당 3대 원칙’을 제시했다. 그는 “민주당원의 찬성, 혁신당원의 찬성, 그리고 민주당 당명과 정체성 유지. 이 세가지 조건이 다 맞으면 합당할 수 있다”면서도 “세가지 조건 중 하나라도 맞지 않으면 그때는 연대하면 된다”고 말했다. 합당의 필요성 자체를 부인하지는 않았지만, ‘당명과 정체성 유지’를 조건으로 걸며 합당을 최우선으로 추진하진 않겠다는 뜻을 내비친 것이다. )

item.title: Song Min-soon: "China Views North Korea's Nuclear Program as an 'Asset, Not a Burden' Since Iran War" (송민순 “중국, 이란전쟁 이후 북핵을 ‘부담 아닌 자산’으로 인식”)
item.description:
A diagnosis has emerged that North Korea's denuclearization has become more difficult as the rivalry between major powers intensifies due to the U.S.-led Iran War, and China has emphasized "North Korea's nuclear program as an asset" to strengthen its sphere of influence in East Asia. (미국이 벌인 이란전쟁으로 강대국 간 세력권 다툼이 강해지고 중국이 동아시아에서 세력권을 강화하기 위해 “북핵을 자산”으로 강조하면서 북한 비핵화는 더욱 어려워졌다는 진단이 나왔다.)

Former Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade Song Min-soon stated at a symposium titled "The Future of National Security and International Order Reshaped by the Iran War," hosted by the Korea Future Forum on the 15th, that the United States is likely to refrain from overseas interventions after the Iran War, much like it did after withdrawing from the Vietnam War. He predicted a high probability of a "sphere-of-influence order" being established, where the U.S. and China refrain from interfering in each other's domains. (송민순 전 외교통상부 장관은 15일 한반도미래포럼이 주최한 ‘이란전쟁이 바꿀 국가안보와 국제질서의 미래’ 심포지엄에서 미국이 과거 베트남 전쟁에서 철군한 뒤 그랬던 것처럼 이란전쟁 이후 해외 개입을 자제할 것이라면서 미국과 중국이 서로의 영역에 간섭하지 않는 ‘세력권 질서’가 구축될 가능성이 크다고 봤다.)

Former Minister Song analyzed that "China, in a situation where the U.S. is losing international trust after the Iran War, is reaping windfall gains and demanding recognition of its influence in the Asia-Pacific region." He noted that during the Iran War, at the May U.S.-China summit, President Xi Jinping directly demonstrated resolve regarding the Taiwan Strait and then visited North Korea for the first time in seven years, "reaffirming China's will to maintain its sphere of influence in Northeast Asia." This, he said, is a significant move in that context. (송 전 장관은 “중국은 미국이 이란전쟁 이후 국제사회의 신뢰를 상실하고 있는 상황에서 반사이익을 얻으면서 아시아·태평양 지역에서 중국의 영향력을 인정하라는 요구를 하고 있다”고 분석했다. 이란전쟁 와중인 5월 미-중 정상회담에서 시진핑 주석이 직설적으로 대만해협에 대한 결의를 보였고 곧바로 7년 만에 북한을 방문해 “동북아에 대한 중국의 세력권 의지를 재확인”한 것이 그런 흐름 속의 중요한 움직임이란 것이다.)

In particular, Former Minister Song analyzed that signs of a military bloc of South Korea, the U.S., and Japan versus North Korea, China, and Russia are emerging in East Asia. In this context, China views North Korea's nuclear capability as "an asset, not a burden," in order to counter the U.S., and the term "denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula" is disappearing from China's national strategy documents and North Korea-China summit meetings. (특히 송 전 장관은 동아시아에서 한·미·일 대 북·중·러의 군사 블록이 등장할 조짐을 보이고 있고 이런 맥락에서 중국은 미국에 대항하기 위해 북한의 핵 능력을 “짐이 아닌 자산”으로 간주하면서 중국의 국가전략문서나 북-중 정상회담에서 ‘조선반도 비핵화’가 사라지고 있다고 분석했다.)

Former Minister Song stated that the Iran War has further solidified confrontational conditions on the Korean Peninsula, making discussion of denuclearization practically impossible. He said, "The possibility of meaningful North Korea-U.S. dialogue has become even slimmer, and the U.S., due to the Iran War, has found it more difficult to justify dialogue." (송 전 장관은 이란전쟁이 한반도에서 대결적 정세를 더 굳히는 효과를 가져와 비핵화 문제는 논의 자체가 사실상 불가능한 상태에 들어갔다면서, “의미 있는 북-미 대화의 가능성은 더 희박해지고 미국도 이란 전쟁으로 인해 대화의 명분을 찾기가 더 어려워졌다”고 말했다.)

Regarding South Korea's strategy to respond to this situation, Former Minister Song said, "Efforts to ease tensions and manage crises to enhance military stability on the Korean Peninsula are important," but added that advocating for 'peaceful coexistence' premised on exchange and cooperation is currently unrealistic. He proposed that a practical approach is to "maintain a robust response capability to deter threats and provocations, while sustaining a 'negative peace (cold peace)' based on non-interference and non-threat, and only when internal changes occur in North Korea can we expect a 'positive peace (warm peace)' through exchange and cooperation." Former Minister Song emphasized, "It is right to transition wartime operational control (OPCON) as early as possible. Despite some concerns, the OPCON transition will elevate the morale and capabilities of the South Korean military to a higher level, and correspondingly enhance South Korea's external standing in managing the situation on the Korean Peninsula." (송 전 장관은 이런 상황에 대응할 한국의 전략에 대해 “한반도에서 군사적 안정을 제고하기 위한 긴장 완화와 위기관리 노력은 중요하다”면서도 현재로서는 교류협력을 전제로 하는 ‘평화 공존’을 내세우는 것은 현실적이지 않다고 말했다. 그는 “지금은 위협과 도발을 억제하는 견고한 대응능력을 유지하면서, 불간섭과 불위협을 기조로 한 ‘소극적 평화(차가운 평화)’를 유지해야 하고, 북한 자체의 변화가 초래될 때 비로소 교류와 협력을 통한 ‘적극적 평화(따뜻한 평화)’를 기대”하는 것이 현실적인 방안이라고 제안했다. 송 전 장관은 “전시작전통제권(전작권)은 가급적 조기에 전환하는 것이 맞다”면서 “일각의 우려에도 불구하고 전작권 전환은 한국군의 사기와 능력을 한 차원 높은 단계로 발전시킬 것이고 한반도 정세관리에 있어 한국의 대외 위상도 그만큼 제고될 것”이라고 강조했다.)

Chairman of the Korea Future Forum, Chun Young-woo, said in his welcoming remarks, "The Iran War has shown that even the United States, a global superpower, cannot subdue every country with force alone and there are problems it cannot solve." He continued, "The aftermath of the Iran War will not only strengthen Iran's hegemony in the Middle East and reshape the region's strategic landscape, but also significantly impact U.S.-China strategic competition, the U.S. alliance system, East Asia and the Korean Peninsula, and even the global order." (천영우 한반도미래포럼 이사장은 환영사에서 “천하의 초강대국 미국도 힘만으로는 굴복시킬 수 없는 나라도 있고, 해결할 수 없는 문제도 있다는 사실을 보여준 게 이란 전쟁”이라고 평가했다. 이어 “이란 전쟁의 여파가 중동지역에서 이란의 패권을 강화시켜주고 중동의 전략적 지형을 재편하는 것으로 끝나는 게 아니라 미-중 전략경쟁, 미국의 동맹체제, 동아시아와 한반도, 나아가 세계 질서에까지 적지 않은 영향을 미칠 것”이라고 전망했다.)

Former Ambassador to Iran Song Woong-yeop stated, "The Iran War was an unnecessary war triggered by Trump's unilateral withdrawal from the 2018 Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA)," and described it as "a war the U.S. did not win, and a war Iran did not lose." Former Ambassador Song predicted, "The U.S. will face the most difficult negotiations in world history as it clashes with the millennia-old bargaining skills of Persian merchants." He also noted, "A state of instability with small deals and ongoing negotiations is likely to persist. Compared to the U.S., which faces midterm elections in November, Iran is not pressed for time." However, he added, "If, in discussing the issue of Hormuz Strait transit fees, an approach is taken that recognizes the sovereignty of surrounding countries over the Strait of Hormuz, drawing on the Malacca Strait model, with user nations making voluntary contributions, a comprehensive agreement could be possible." (송웅엽 전 주이란대사는 “이란전쟁은 트럼프의 2018년 이란 핵합의(JCPOA)의 일방적 탈퇴 때문에 벌어진 불필요한 전쟁”이라면서 “미국 입장에서는 이기지 못한 전쟁, 이란 입장에서는 지지 않은 전쟁”이라고 했다. 송 전 대사는 그러면서 “미국은 수천년 페르시아 상인의 협상술과 부딪히면서 세계 역사상 가장 힘든 협상을 하게 될 것”이라고 전망했다. 송 전 대사는 또 “스몰딜과 협상이 지속되는 불안정한 상태가 지속될 가능성이 높다”면서 “11월 중간선거를 앞둔 미국에 비해 이란은 시간에 쫓기지 않는다”고 짚었다. 다만 “호르무즈 통항료(수수료) 문제를 논의하는 과정에서 말라카해협 방식을 원용해 호르무즈해협에 대한 주변국의 주권을 인정하되 이용국들이 자발적 기여를 하는 방식으로 논의하면 포괄적 합의도 가능하다”고 말했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Party and government decide to establish integrated military academy at "Jaundae" in Daejeon ([속보] 당정, 통합 사관학교 대전 ‘자운대’에 창설하기로)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea and the government decided on the 16th to establish the National Military Academy, merging the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies, at Jaundae in Daejeon. (더불어민주당과 정부는 16일 육·해·공군사관학교를 통합한 국군사관학교를 대전 자운대에 창설하기로 했다.)

Minister of National Defense Ahn Gyu-baek made this announcement following a party-government consultation held at the National Assembly Members' Office Building. Minister Ahn stated, "To cultivate officers suited to future security environments, a new educational system, excellent faculty, and state-of-the-art educational facilities are essential at this point," adding, "The newly established National Military Academy, located in the Jaundae area of Daejeon, will produce officers equipped with creativity, convergent thinking, expertise, and technological sensitivity." (안규백 국방부 장관은 이날 국회 의원회관에서 열린 당·정협의 뒤 이렇게 발표했다. 안 장관은 “미래의 안보 환경에 부합하는 장교 양성을 위해서는 새로운 교육 체계, 우수한 교수진, 최첨단 교육 환경이 반드시 필요한 시점”이라며 “새롭게 출범할 국군사관학교는 대전 자운대 지역에서 위치해 창의성과 융합성의 사고, 전문성과 기술 감수성이 구비된 장교를 양성해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Park Ji-won: "Yoo Si-min, Who Tormented DJ for 5 Years, Now Shakes President Lee" (박지원 “DJ 5년 내내 괴롭혔던 유시민, 이젠 이 대통령 흔들어”)
item.description:
Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Park Ji-won on the 16th criticized author Yoo Si-min for saying President Lee Jae-myung’s governance is "heading toward inevitable failure," stating, "Tormenting DJ (former President Kim Dae-jung) for five years was enough. (Now) help (President Lee)." (박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 16일 이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대해 “필연적 실패의 길로 가고 있다”고 비판한 유시민 작가를 향해 “디제이(DJ·김대중 전 대통령) 5년을 괴롭혔으면 그것으로 충분하다. (이 대통령을) 도와달라”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that day, Park said, "We must help President Lee Jae-myung head toward inevitable success so that the insurrection forces cannot emerge." (박 의원은 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “이재명 대통령을 도와 필연적 성공의 길로 가야 내란세력이 등장 못 한다”며 이같이 말했다.)

The previous day, Yoo appeared on the YouTube show "Mae Bool Show," where he directly criticized President Lee’s integration and pragmatism-driven governance, saying, "I respect the path President Lee has chosen, but it is a very dangerous choice for both him and society. I believe President Lee’s choice will end in failure." (유 작가는 전날 유튜브 방송 ‘매불쇼’에 출연해 이 대통령의 통합·실용 국정기조에 대해 “이 대통령이 선택한 노선을 존중하는데 그것은 본인에게도, 사회에도 매우 위험한 선택이다. 이 대통령의 선택이 실패로 끝날 것이라고 본다”고 정면 비판했다.)

In response, Park referenced former President Kim Dae-jung, saying, "As a progressive intellectual, who does author Yoo Si-min see as an alternative, that he would shake up President Lee Jae-myung, who has only been in office for just over a year?" He added, "During the 1997 presidential election, Yoo supported conservative candidate Cho Soon, his mentor, and famously argued for the inevitability of DJ’s defeat, but the people chose President DJ." (이에 대해 박 의원은 김대중 전 대통령을 언급하며 “진보적 지식인인 유시민 작가는 누구를 대안으로 두고 이제 갓 1년 지난 이재명 대통령을 흔들어댈까”라며 “그는 1997년 대선 때 그의 은사이신 보수정당 조순 후보를 지지하며 그 유명한 DJ필패론을 역설했지만 DJ대통령을 국민은 선택했다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Author Yoo shook up and tormented the DJ government for all five years. Despite his malicious interference, DJ was recorded as the most historically and nationally successful president, and even now, he is the most respected president by the world and our people." (이어 그는 “유 작가는 디제이(DJ)정부 5년 내내 흔들고 괴롭혔다. 그의 패악질 훼방에도 불구하고 DJ는 역사적 국민적 가장 성공한 대통령으로 기록되었고 지금도 세계와 우리 국민이 가장 존경하는 대통령이다”고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding Yoo’s "inevitable failure" remarks, Park rebutted, "President Lee Jae-myung is also heading toward inevitable success, not inevitable failure, despite his baseless shaking." He added, "In his first year in office, he restored democracy, and the three major reforms to settle the insurrection are proceeding successfully." (박 의원은 유 작가의 “필연적 실패” 발언에 대해서 “이재명 대통령도 그의 이유 없는 흔들림에도 필연적 실패의 길이 아니라 필연적 성공의 길로 가고 있다”며 “집권 1년 차에 민주주의를 회복시켰고 내란청산 3대개혁은 성공적으로 진행되고 있다”고 반박했다.)

On Yoo’s claim that "the reason prosecutorial reform has not been achieved in over a year is because the president does not want complete separation of investigation and prosecution," Park responded, "Regarding his criticism of prosecutorial reform, he denounces President Lee, invoking Machiavelli without any public statement from him, but President Lee has publicly and repeatedly affirmed the principle of separating investigation and prosecution powers to our people and recently said that the issue of supplementary investigation authority should be deliberated in the National Assembly." (“검찰 개혁이 1년이 넘도록 안 이뤄지는 이유는 대통령이 수사·기소 완전 분리를 원하지 않기 때문”이라는 유 작가의 주장에 대해서도 박 의원은 “그가 지적하는 검찰개혁만 하더라도 그는 이 대통령의 공개발언 없이 마키아벨리 운운하며 비난하지만 (이 대통령은) 우리 국민께 누차에 걸쳐 검찰의 수사 기소 분리 원칙을 공개적으로 천명, 최근의 보완수사권 문제도 국회에서 숙의토록 말씀했다”고 했다.)

Reporter Lee Seung-joon gamja@hani.co.kr (이승준 기자 gamja@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Jaemyung-ah" Jang Dong-hyuk Now Holds Sign Saying "Lee Jae-myung is the Leader of Insurrection" (“재명아” 장동혁, 이번엔 “이재명이 내란수괴” 손팻말)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, who faced criticism for "vulgar politics" after holding a sign that said "Jaemyung-ah, fight me" in an informal tone, has now held a sign reading "Lee Jae-myung is the leader of insurrection." (“재명아, 나랑 싸우자”는 반말 손팻말을 들어 ‘막말 정치’ 비판을 받는 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 이번에는 “이재명이 내란수괴”라고 적힌 손팻말을 들었다.)

On the 15th, Rep. Jang attended a rally titled "June 3 Disenfranchisement Incident" held in front of the Gwangju-Jeonnam Regional Election Commission. After arriving and greeting participants, as he sat down, a young man approached and handed him a sign that read, "Stealing ballots is true insurrection! Lee Jae-myung is the leader of insurrection." ( 장 대표는 15일 전남광주통합특별시 선거관리위원회 앞에서 열린 ‘6·3 참정권 박탈 사태 집회’에 참석했다. 집회 현장에 도착해 참가자들과 인사를 마친 장 대표가 자리에 앉자 한 청년이 다가와 “투표용지 빼돌린 게 진짜 내란! 이재명이 내란수괴”라 쓰인 손팻말을 전달했다. )

Upon reading the text on the sign, Rep. Jang smiled broadly and even waved the sign during the rally. ( 손팻말에 적힌 문구를 살펴본 장 대표는 환하게 웃었고 집회가 진행되는 동안 해당 손팻말을 잡고 흔들기도 했다. )

At the rally, there was also a participant holding a sign that read, "Jaemyung-ah, fight me instead of a high school student," which matched the sign Jang had held on the 7th at a "vote-counting site blockade protest" in front of the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Another participant posed for photos with Rep. Jang holding a sign that said, "Fraudulent impeachment of Presidents Park Geun-hye and Yoon Seok-youl! Null and void!" Signs reading "Fake President Lee Jae-myung's Election Invalid," "Special Counsel for the Election Commission," and "Martial Law Was Justified! YOON AGAIN" were also visible. <<> During the rally, Rep. Jang said, "You are the June 3 citizen revolutionary army protecting the voting rights and democracy of the Republic of Korea," and added, "I am willing to stake my political life on protecting the precious votes of the people." He became emotional, saying, "If there is ever a time in our lives when we must feel anger just once, and if there is ever a time when we receive history's call and must risk our lives, then today is that moment." Only two lawmakers from the People Power Party attended the rally: Rep. Jo Bae-sook from the Honam region and Rep. Park Jun-tae, chief of staff for the party leader. <<> Previously, on the 7th, Rep. Jang held a sign saying, "Jaemyung-ah, fight me instead of a high school student," and on the 11th, one reading, "Jaemyung-ah, you saw it? Heard it? Then you should accept a special counsel," drawing criticism from both ruling and opposition parties. <<> On the 8th, Rep. Park Ji-won of the Democratic Party noted in a plenary session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, "Even if harsh words are exchanged in politics, at least we should uphold the principle of respecting the head of state and the president." On the 9th, Democratic Party floor leader Rep. Han Byung-do criticized at a policy coordination meeting, calling it "an extremely vulgar act," and said, "Rep. Jang's crude vulgar politics has crossed the line." <<> Criticism also came from within the People Power Party. Following a critique by Kim Geun-sik, head of the Songpa-gu chapter of the People Power Party in Seoul, who said on the 11th, "No matter how wrong the president is, 'Jaemyung-ah' is not the language of politics. It's just the excrement of vulgar words spewed by far-right extremists," Rep. Kwak Kyu-taek of the same party pointed out on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" on the 15th, "For a leader of a major party to address the president by his given name in such a manner is a matter of decorum that should be considered even within the party." <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr ( 집회 현장에는 “재명아, 고등학생 말고 나랑 싸우자”고 적힌 손팻말을 든 참가자도 있었는데 이는 지난 7일 장 대표가 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 앞 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’에서 들었던 손팻말과 같은 내용이다. 또 다른 참가자는 “박근혜 윤석열 대통령 사기 탄핵! 원천무효!”라고 적힌 손팻말을 들고 장 대표와 사진을 찍었다. “가짜 대통령 이재명 당선무효”, “선관위 특검”, “계엄은 정당했다! YOON AGAIN(윤 어게인)”이라고 적힌 손팻말도 보였다.)

item.title: Blue House Establishes New Secretary for Youth and Future Affairs; Former Google Korea Executive Kim Tae-won Appointed (청와대 청년미래비서관 신설…구글코리아 전무 출신 김태원 임명)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung has created the new position of Secretary for Youth and Future Affairs at the Blue House and appointed Kim Tae-won (46), co-CEO of InnoRed and a former executive at Google Korea, to the post. (이재명 대통령이 청와대 청년미래비서관직을 신설하고 구글코리아 전무 출신인 김태원(46) 이노레드 공동대표를 임명했다.)

According to a Blue House briefing on the 16th, Secretary Kim started reporting to the Blue House and began his duties that day. The Secretary for Youth and Future Affairs has been placed under the Chief of Staff to the President, and the Youth Affairs Officer, previously under the Secretary for National Unity, has also been relocated to the newly established secretary's office. This is the first time a youth secretary position has been created at the Blue House since the Moon Jae-in administration. The move appears to be aimed at actively incorporating the voices of young people into policies and formulating related measures, amid deepening discontent among the youth demographic. (16일 청와대 설명을 들어보면, 김 비서관은 이날부터 청와대로 출근해 업무를 시작했다. 청년미래비서관은 대통령비서실장 산하에 배치됐고, 국민통합비서관 소속이었던 청년담당관도 청년미래비서관 산하로 이동했다. 청와대에 청년비서관이 신설된 건 문재인 정부 이후 처음이다. 청년층의 민심 이반 현상이 심화하면서, 이들의 목소리를 정책에 적극적으로 반영하고 관련 대책을 수립하기 위한 차원으로 보인다.)

Secretary Kim worked at Google for 18 years, serving as Managing Director and Executive Director at Google Korea, and is a renowned expert in the marketing field. He joined InnoRed, an independent advertising agency, in 2024. (김 비서관은 18년간 구글에 재직하며, 구글코리아 상무와 전무 등을 지낸 대표적인 마케팅 분야 전문가다. 독립광고회사인 이노레드에는 지난 2024년 합류했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Respond Thoroughly to Distribution of False and Manipulated Information… Must Prevent Abuse" (이 대통령 “허위·조작 정보 유통 철저히 대응…악용 막아야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 16th, "Please respond very thoroughly to the distribution of illegal and false/manipulated information, and strive to prepare and prevent it." (이재명 대통령이 16일 “불법과 허위조작 정보 유통에 대해 아주 철저하게 대응하고, 예비·예방할 수 있도록 노력해달라”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a briefing on the affairs of the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission, and the Personal Information Protection Commission, which he chaired at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House. He said, "While the role of the Broadcasting and Communications Commission includes promoting broadcasting and communications, it is far more important to ensure they are not abused." President Lee added, "I believe the regulatory body must do its job well concerning the abuse of false and fake information for private gain, as a means of political attack, and for triggering social division and conflict." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 주재한 과학기술정보통신부·방송미디어통신위원회·개인정보보호위원회 업무보고에서 “방송통신위원회의 역할은 방송·통신을 진흥하는 것도 중요하지만, 악용되지 않도록 하는 것이 훨씬 더 중요하다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “문제는 허위·가짜 정보를 악용해 사적 이익을 취하거나 정치적 공격 수단으로 삼고, 사회적 분열과 갈등을 촉발하는 부분에 대해 규제기관으로서 역할을 잘해야 할 것 같다”고 했다.)

President Lee continued, "The social costs from fake information and false incitement are too great, aren't they? For example, doesn't it lead to a complete loss of rationality?" He said, "Since it's only about my interests and your interests, making this into a set of norms and order is what the Broadcasting and Communications Commission needs to do." (이 대통령은 이어 “가짜 정보, 허위 선동으로 인한 사회적 비용이 너무 크지 않냐. 예를 들면 합리성을 다 잃어버리지 않냐”며 “오로지 나의 이익, 너의 이익 이런 것만 있는 거니까 이걸 일정한 규범과 질서로 만들어내는 게 방통위가 할 일”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee on Coupang Controversy: "Penalties Not Targeted... They Are Based on the Law" (이 대통령, 쿠팡 논란에 “과징금, 표적 아냐… 법에 따른 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 15th, "Recently, the scale of penalties (for personal information leaks) has increased, and it seems some companies are arguing, 'Isn't this targeting only me?'" He added, "It would be good to fully explain that these measures were taken based on the law and policy, without considering the characteristics of the companies at all." This statement is interpreted as being made with Coupang in mind, which was recently slapped with a massive fine by the Personal Information Protection Commission for a personal information leak. (이재명 대통령이 15일 “최근 (개인정보 유출에 대한) 과징금 규모가 커졌는데, 여기에 대해 ‘나만 표적으로 하는 거 아니냐’고 주장하는 기업이 있는 것 같다”며 “기업 특성을 전혀 고려하지 않고 법과 방침에 따라 한 것이라는 점을 충분히 설명하면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 최근 개인정보 유출과 관련해 개인정보보호위원회로부터 거액의 과징금을 부과받은 쿠팡을 염두에 둔 발언으로 해석된다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a briefing from the Personal Information Protection Commission held at the Cheong Wa Dae Guesthouse. He said, "In the area of personal information protection, companies have been somewhat indifferent. If a leak occurs, they patch it up moderately because that costs less than security expenses, so it's effectively neglected. Then incidents keep happening until a large-scale leak occurs," adding, "There's a high possibility that there are many (information leaks) we are unaware of." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 주재한 개인정보보호위원회 업무보고에서 “개인정보보호 부분은 관련 기업들이 관심이 좀 떨어지고 유출돼 봐야 적당하게 때우는 게 보안 비용보다 적게 드니까 사실상 방치하다, 사고가 계속 발생하다가 대규모로 유출 사고가 발생한다”며 “우리가 모르는 (정보유출도) 많을 가능성이 있다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "We need to drastically increase sanctions for personal information leaks or misuse, in line with our set policies, to far exceed the cost of protecting personal information. That way, companies will actually engage in personal information protection activities, won't they?" (그러면서 이 대통령은 “저희가 방침을 정한 대로 개인정보 유출이나 악용에 대해 제재금을 대규모로 대폭 올려 개인정보 보호 비용을 훨씬 초과하게 만들어야 실제로는 개인정보 보호 활동을 할 거 아니냐”고 덧붙였다.)

Previously, the Personal Information Protection Commission imposed a penalty of 624.6 billion won on Coupang last month for a large-scale personal information leak. Recently, the White House stated regarding this, "The U.S. government has ongoing concerns about regulations and law enforcement targeting or discriminating against American technology companies, including Coupang, by the South Korean government." (앞서 개인정보보호위원회는 지난달 대규모 개인정보 유출 사고에 대해 쿠팡에 6246억원의 과징금을 부과했다. 백악관은 최근 이를 두고 “미국 정부는 쿠팡을 포함한 미국 기술 기업을 표적으로 삼거나 차별하는 규제 및 법 집행과 관련해 한국 정부에 대해 지속적인 우려를 갖고 있다”는 입장을 밝힌 바 있다.)

Seo Young-ji, reporter yj@hani.co.kr Yoo Young-jae, reporter young@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Jeom-sik and Lee Jun-seok to hold lunch meeting on the 21st… Discussing cooperation in anti-government struggle (정점식·이준석 21일 오찬 회동…대여 투쟁 공조 논의)
item.description:
Jeong Jeom-sik, the floor leader of the People Power Party, and Lee Jun-seok, the leader of the Reform Party, will hold a lunch meeting on the 21st. (정점식 국민의힘 원내대표와 이준석 개혁신당 대표가 21일 오찬 회동을 한다.)

On the 16th, Leader Lee met with reporters at the National Assembly and said, “Floor Leader Jeong previously visited the Reform Party and suggested having a meal together, so the schedule was set,” adding, “There has been a tendency for opposition party exchanges to disappear amid the ruling-opposition conflict, and this seems to be an attempt to restore that.” Floor Leader Jeong had visited the Reform Party leadership on the 15th of last month, shortly after taking office as floor leader. The meeting is expected to discuss cooperation strategies in the anti-government struggle, including the abolition of prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights and the introduction of a special counsel investigation into the National Election Commission. (이 대표는 16일 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “정 원내대표가 예전에 개혁신당을 예방해 식사 한번 하자는 취지로 말해서 (일정이) 잡혔다”며 “여야가 대립하며 야당 교류가 사라진 측면이 있는데, 이를 복원하려는 것 같다”고 말했다. 정 원내대표는 원내대표 취임 직후였던 지난달 15일 개혁신당 지도부를 예방한 바 있다. 회동에서는 검사의 보완수사권 폐지와 선거관리위원회 특검 도입 등에 대한 대여 투쟁 공조 방안이 논의될 것으로 보인다.)

The People Power Party and the Reform Party have recently been engaged in a dispute over the case of Jeong Yi-han, a former Reform Party candidate for Busan mayor, who was arrested on charges of staging a self-inflicted attack during the June 3 local elections. Leader Lee stated, “There is a position advocating for cooperation on a special counsel, but some figures within the People Power Party and those expelled from it are attacking the Reform Party, raising doubts about their true intentions. I will discuss with Floor Leader Jeong whether there is any relevance to such matters, and though I do not believe it is organized, I will ensure that the anti-government cooperation does not take an unexpected turn.” (국민의힘과 개혁신당은 최근 6·3 지방선거 당시 피습 자작극을 벌인 혐의로 구속된 정이한 전 개혁신당 부산시장 후보 사건과 관련 공방을 벌이고 있다. 이 대표는 “특검 공조를 하자는 입장이 있는데, 일부 국민의힘 인사와 (국민의힘에서) 쫓겨난 인사가 개혁신당에 대해 공세해 진의가 의심된다”며 “정 원내대표와 그런 부분에 대해서 어떤 개연성이 있는지, 조직적이라고 생각하지 않지만 대여 공조에 있어 뜬금없는 흐름으로 가지 않게 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Many Abuses Occur as Fines for AI-Generated Content Marking Are Suspended" (이 대통령 “AI 생성물 표시 과태료 유예하니 악용 많아”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 16th that the effectiveness of mandatory labeling for videos and images created by artificial intelligence (AI) must be strengthened. As AI-generated content becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from real footage, he emphasized the need to tighten penalties for violations of labeling obligations to prevent the spread of false information. (이재명 대통령이 16일 인공지능(AI)으로 제작한 영상·이미지에 대한 표시 의무의 실효성을 강화해야 한다고 밝혔다. 인공지능 생성물과 실제 영상의 구분이 어려워진 만큼 표시 의무 위반에 대한 제재를 강화해 허위정보 확산을 막아야 한다는 취지다.)

During a briefing from the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission, and the Personal Information Protection Commission at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, President Lee said, "These days, AI-generated works are so similar to real footage that it's hard to tell whether it's an AI creation or an actual scene. The performance has truly improved dramatically." He added, "But if they aren't labeled as AI, people will believe it's real, which could cause serious misunderstandings." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 주재한 과학기술정보통신부·방송미디어통신위원회·개인정보보호위원회 업무보고에서 “요즘은 인공지능 창작물인지, 실제 상황인지 구분이 안 될 정도로 실제 영상과 매우 유사하다. 정말 성능이 엄청 개선됐다”며 “그런데 (인공지능이라고) 표시를 안 하면 사람들이 진짜라고 믿게 되고 오해를 심하게 유발할 것 같다”고 말했다.)

President Lee continued, "If this is exploited, it could be really serious." He noted, "Because the penalties for violating AI-generated content labeling are suspended, many people are abusing it. We need to think about how to enforce sanctions." He also asked, "Does requiring labeling as AI truly hinder the development of the AI industry?" (이 대통령은 이어 “이게 악용되면 정말 심각하다”며 “(인공지능 생성물 표시 의무 위반에 대한 제재를) 유예하니까 악용하는 사람도 많다. 제재를 어떻게 할지 고민해봐야 할 것 같다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “인공지능이라고 표시하는 것이 과연 인공지능 산업 발전에 장애가 되느냐”고 묻기도 했다.)

In response, Kim Jong-cheol, Chairman of the Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission, said, "The development of AI technology and user protection must go hand in hand." He added, "Just as personal information protection has become an essential foundational cost, preventing the misuse of AI and promoting industrial development should proceed in parallel." The Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission reported that while current regulations impose a fine of up to 30 million won for violating AI-generated content labeling obligations, the imposition of fines is currently suspended for one year. (이에 김종철 방송미디어통신위원장은 “인공지능 기술 발전과 이용자 보호는 함께 가야 한다”며 “개인정보 보호가 이제 필수 기반 비용이 된 것처럼 인공지능 오남용 방지와 산업 발전도 병행해야 한다”고 답했다. 방송미디어통신위원회는 현재 인공지능 생성물 표시 의무를 위반하면 3000만원 이하의 과태료를 부과하도록 규정돼 있지만, 과태료 부과는 1년간 유예된 상태라고 보고했다.)

According to the "Basic Act on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and the Creation of a Trust Foundation (AI Basic Act)," which took effect on January 22, images and videos generated by AI must be marked with watermarks or similar indicators so that users can clearly recognize them. However, the government has suspended the imposition of fines for one year, considering the need for the system to settle in the field and for companies to prepare. (지난 1월22일부터 시행된 ‘인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법(인공지능 기본법)’에 따르면 인공지능으로 생성된 이미지와 영상 등에는 이용자가 명확하게 인식할 수 있도록 워터마크 등 표시를 해야 한다. 다만 정부는 제도의 현장 안착과 기업의 준비 기간 등을 고려해 과태료 부과를 1년간 유예하고 있다.)

item.title: Kwon Seong-dong, Losing Parliamentary Seat: "I Hope This Political Retaliation Ends With Me" (‘의원직 상실’ 권성동 “정치 보복, 저 하나로 마무리되길”)
item.description:
Kwon Seong-dong, a People Power Party lawmaker who lost his parliamentary seat after being sentenced to two years in prison for receiving 100 million won in illegal political funds from the Unification Church, stated on the 16th, "I hope this political retaliation ends with me." (통일교 쪽으로부터 불법 정치자금 1억원을 받은 혐의로 징역 2년형이 확정돼 의원직을 상실한 권성동 국민의힘 의원이 16일 “정치보복이 저 하나로 마무리되길 바란다”고 밝혔다.)

In a statement released that day, Kwon said, "I cannot hide deep regret over the factual judgment and legal application. I will humbly accept the final ruling of the judiciary." (권 의원은 이날 입장문을 내어 “사실 판단과 법리 적용에 대해 깊은 아쉬움을 감출 수 없다. 사법부의 최종 판단을 겸허히 받아들이겠다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Kwon continued, "Last September, I announced I would waive my immunity from arrest. That was because I was confident in my innocence and was aboveboard. However, I made one earnest plea: I asked that political retaliation end with me." He added, "Destruction of political opponents should not be the goal of politics. The mobilization of state agencies to bring down one person, and the shaking of laws and institutions to collapse a party, must stop." (이어 권 의원은 “지난해 9월 저는 불체포특권을 포기하겠다고 밝혔다. 스스로 결백하고 당당했기 때문”이라며 “다만 한 가지는 간곡히 호소했다. 부디 정치 보복은 저 하나로 끝내달라는 요청이었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “정적을 꺾는 일이 정치의 목적이 되어서는 안 된다. 한 사람을 쓰러뜨리기 위해 국가기관을 동원되고, 한 정당을 무너뜨리기 위해 법과 제도를 흔드는 일은 이제 멈추어야 한다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik, speaking to reporters at the National Assembly immediately after the sentencing, said, "We humbly accept the Supreme Court's ruling," but also noted, "Special counsel Min Joong-ki exceeded the statute of limitations regarding suspicions of bribery against Busan Mayor Jeon Jae-su and only launched investigations into opposition politicians. Guilty verdicts for the opposition, acquittals for the ruling party, oppression of the opposition, and biased investigations will surely face historical judgment." He then called on the Supreme Court, saying, "We hope the Supreme Court will work to expedite the resumption of the five trials concerning the highest authority." This was a reference to the trials of President Lee Jae-myung, which were halted after his inauguration. <<> Earlier, the Supreme Court's second division (presided by Justice Eom Sang-pil) upheld the lower court's sentence of two years in prison and a fine of 100 million won for Kwon, who was indicted on charges of violating the Political Funds Act. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (정점식 원내대표는 선고 직후 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “대법원 판결을 겸허히 받아들인다”면서도 “민중기 특검은 전재수 부산시장의 뇌물수수 의혹에 대해선 공소시효를 초과하고 야당 정치인에 대해서만 수사를 착수했다. 야당 유죄, 여당 무죄, 야당탄압, 편파 수사는 반드시 역사 심판받을 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 대법원을 향해 “최고권력자에 대한 5개 재판을 조속히 재개될 수 있도록 대법원이 노력해주길 바란다”고 했다. 이재명 대통령의 재판이 대통령 취임 뒤 중단된 것을 겨냥한 것이다.)

item.title: President Lee's Approval Rating at 55%…Opposition to Unified Military Academy at 55% [NBS] (이 대통령 지지율 55%…통합 사관학교 반대 55% [NBS])
item.description:
A poll released on the 16th showed that approval of President Lee Jae-myung's administration stands at 55%. The rate of opposition to the integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies was 55%, higher than the rate of support (34%). (이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정 평가가 55%를 기록했다는 여론조사 결과가 16일 나왔다. 육·해·공군 사관학교 통합에 반대하는 비율은 55%로, 찬성(34%)보다 높았다.)

According to the National Barometer Survey (NBS) conducted by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research from the 13th to the 15th (a telephone interview survey with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), the positive assessment that President Lee is 'doing well' in running state affairs was 55%. In the previous survey from the first week of July, it was 58%. The negative assessment that he is 'doing poorly' was 34%, with 11% responding 'don't know' or refusing to answer. <<> The approval rating for the Democratic Party of Korea was 38%, while the People Power Party's approval rating rose to 22%. The Reform Party was at 3%, the Fatherland Innovation Party at 2%, and the Progressive Party at 2%. <<> Regarding the integration of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, 55% opposed it, stating that 'it would weaken each branch's expertise and distinctiveness,' which was higher than the 34% who supported integration, saying 'it would strengthen joint operational capabilities among the Army, Navy, and Air Force.' item.title: Democratic Party Decides to Postpone Korea Football Association Hearing Scheduled for the 22nd… “People Power Party Must Join” (민주, 22일 축구협회 청문회 연기하기로…“국힘 함께 해야”)
item.description:
The National Assembly’s Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee has decided to postpone the hearing on the Korea Football Association, originally scheduled for the 22nd. As negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties on the formation of the standing committees for the latter half of the 22nd National Assembly remain unfinished, the hearing will be rescheduled within the July extraordinary session to allow both parties to participate jointly. (국회 문화체육관광위원회가 오는 22일 열기로 했던 대한축구협회 청문회를 연기하기로 했다. 여야 간 22대 국회 후반기 상임위원회 원 구성 협상이 아직 마무리되지 않은 만큼, 여야가 함께 청문회를 열 수 있도록 7월 국회 임시회 안으로 청문회 일정을 다시 잡기로 했다.)

Lawmakers from the Democratic Party of Korea on the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee stated in a press release on the 16th, “The committee has repeatedly called for the participation of the People Power Party since deciding to hold the hearing on the 22nd, but the People Power Party has not joined as of now,” adding, “Considering that negotiations on committee formation are nearing completion, we have decided to adjust the schedule within the bounds allowed by the July parliamentary session to hold a hearing with both parties present if possible.” (문체위 소속 더불어민주당 의원들은 16일 보도자료를 내어 “문체위는 오는 22일 청문회 개최를 의결하며 국민의힘의 참여를 거듭 요청해왔으나 현재까지 국민의힘이 참여하지 않고 있는 상황”이라며 “원 구성 협상이 막바지에 이른 점 등을 감안해, 가급적 여야가 함께하는 청문회를 위해 7월 국회가 허용하는 범위 내에서 일정을 조정하기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

They further noted, “Democratic Party members on the committee plan to convene a full committee meeting next week to formally vote on agenda items, including changing the date of the hearing,” and added, “We will prepare the hearing without disruption according to the planned schedule to resolve public suspicions and do our utmost to devise measures to prevent recurrence.” (이어 “민주당 문체위원들은 다음주 중 전체회의를 열어 청문회 개최일 변경 등 관련 안건을 공식 의결할 예정”이라며 “예정된 일정에 따라 청문회를 차질 없이 준비해 국민적 의혹을 해소하고 재발 방지 대책 마련에 최선을 다할 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Earlier, on the 9th, the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee adopted a plan to hold a hearing on issues related to the Korea Football Association, led by the Democratic Party. The hearing aims to investigate allegations of arbitrary management within the football association, address suspicions surrounding the appointment processes of former men’s national football team coaches Hong Myung-bo and Jurgen Klinsmann, and discuss measures to establish an advanced operational system for the association. At that time, the committee had selected former coach Hong and former Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu as witnesses. (앞서 지난 9일 문체위는 대한축구협회 현안 관련 청문회 실시계획서를 민주당 주도로 채택한 바 있다. 문체위는 청문회에서 축구협회의 독단적 운영 의혹 전반에 대한 진상 규명과 홍명보, 위르겐 클리스만 전 남자 축구 국가대표팀 감독의 선임 과정 등에 대한 의혹을 해소하고, 축구협회의 선진적 운영 시스템 정착을 위한 방안을 논의할 예정이다. 당시 문체위는 홍 전 감독과 정몽규 전 대한축구협회장 등을 증인으로 채택한 바 있다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: China's fourth-ranking official Wang Huning meets with Jo Yong-won in Pyongyang… "Tighter strategic communication" (중국 서열 4위 왕후닝, 평양서 조용원과 회담…“전략소통 더 긴밀하게”)
item.description:
China's fourth-ranking official, Wang Huning, chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), who visited North Korea to commemorate the 65th anniversary of the signing of the North Korea-China Friendship and Mutual Assistance Treaty, and Jo Yong-won, secretary of the North Korean Workers' Party Central Committee, pledged to expand bilateral cooperation during their talks. (북중 우호협력 및 상호원조조약(북중 우호조약) 체결 65주년을 기념해 방북한 중국공산당 서열 4위 왕후닝 전국인민정치협상회의(정협) 주석과 조용원 북한 노동당 중앙위원회 비서가 회담에서 양국 협력의 확대를 약속했다.)

The Rodong Sinmun reported the news of the talks with Secretary Jo prominently on its front page on the 16th, along with a photo of Chairman Wang and the Chinese delegation arriving in Pyongyang the previous day. It reported that Secretary Jo and Chairman Wang discussed strengthening party-to-party exchanges between the Workers' Party of Korea and the Chinese Communist Party, deepening cooperation in areas such as economy and culture, and enhancing the welfare of the peoples of both countries. Chairman Wang will remain in Pyongyang until the 17th. (노동신문은 16일 1면에 왕 주석과 중국 대표단이 전날 평양에 도착한 사진과 함께 조 비서와의 회담 소식을 비중있게 전했다. 조 비서와 왕 주석이 조선노동당과 중국공산당의 당적 교류를 강화하고, 경제와 문화 등 여러 분야에서 협조를 심화해 양국 인민의 복리를 증진시키기 위한 문제를 토의했다고 보도했다. 왕 주석은 17일까지 평양에 머무른다.)

Chairman Wang's visit has a strong party-to-party exchange character. The earlier announcement of Wang's visit to North Korea was made by the Chinese Communist Party's International Department, not the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. This high-level serial exchange, where North Korean Cabinet Premier Pak Thae-song visited China from the 10th to the 12th to mark the treaty anniversary, followed by Chairman Wang's visit to North Korea three days later, illustrates a steady flow of exchanges. (왕 주석의 방문은 당 대 당 교류 성격이 짙다. 앞서 중국이 왕 주석 방북을 발표한 것도 외교부가 아닌 중국공산당 대외연락부였다. 우호조약 체결 기념을 계기로 박태성 북한 내각총리가 지난 10∼12일 방중하고, 사흘 뒤 왕 주석이 방북하는 고위급 연쇄 교류 흐름을 보여준다.)

The newspaper reported that Secretary Jo said, "Under the direct attention and wise leadership of Chairman Kim Jong-un and President Xi Jinping, the DPRK-China friendship is entering a new period of vitality in its own development," and "expressed the stance of closely strengthening strategic communication and tactical cooperation between the two parties and two countries, and expanding and developing bilateral relations in multiple directions." Chairman Wang emphasized that "solemnly commemorating the 65th anniversary of the Friendship Treaty is an important common understanding of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries." The newspaper also reported that he "expressed the will to take the important agreements achieved at the Pyongyang summit between Chairman Kim and President Xi as fundamental guidance and push DPRK-China relations to a higher level." (조 비서는 “김정은 국무위원장과 시진핑 국가주석의 직접적인 관심과 현명한 영도 밑에 조중(북중) 친선관계는 자기 발전의 새로운 활력기를 맞이하고 있다”고 말하며 “두 당, 두 나라 사이의 전략적 의사소통과 전술적 협력을 긴밀히 하며 쌍무관계를 다방면으로 확대 발전시켜 나가려는 입장을 표명했다”고 신문은 보도했다. 왕 주석은 “(우호조약) 65돌을 성대히 기념하는 것은 두 당, 두 나라 최고영도자들의 중요한 공동인식”이라고 강조했다. 신문은 그가 “(김 위원장과 시 주석의) 평양 상봉에서 이룩된 중요 합의를 근본 지침으로 삼고 중조관계를 보다 높은 단계로 추동해 나가려는 의지를 피력했다”고도 전했다.)

Attending the talks from the North Korean side were Kim Hyong-sik, vice chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly Presidium; Mun Song-hyok, deputy director of the Workers' Party of Korea Central Committee; Kim Myong-su, vice minister of Foreign Affairs; and Kang Chol-ho, vice minister of Urban Management. From the Chinese side, attending as a party and government delegation were Wang Dongfeng, vice chairman of the CPPCC; Liu Haixing, director of the Chinese Communist Party's International Department; Qi Wei, secretary of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; Pei Jinjia, director of the Veterans Affairs Department; and Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to North Korea. (이번 회담에 북한 쪽에선 최고인민회의 상임위원회 부위원장 김형식과 조선노동당 중앙위원회 부부장 문성혁, 외무성 부상 김명수, 도시경영성 부상 강철호가 참석했다. 중국에선 왕둥펑 정협 부주석과 류하이싱 중국공산당 대외연락부장, 치위 외교부 당위원회 서기, 페이진자 퇴역군인사업부장, 왕야쥔 주북한 중국대사 등 당과 정부 대표단이 배석했다.)

In particular, the participation of North Korea's vice minister of Urban Management and China's director of the Veterans Affairs Department suggests that urban industries and military-related exchanges were discussed in this meeting. Previously, Premier Pak had visited the Beijing Rail Transit Command Center to inspect the status of urban railway construction. Regarding the attendance of Pei Jinjia, director of the Veterans Affairs Department, a Unification Ministry official said on the same day, "President Xi mentioned during his visit to North Korea last month the joint operation and management of Chinese People's Volunteer Army martyr memorial facilities, and their use for revolutionary traditional education and youth ideological education, so this may be related to that." (특히 북한의 도시경영성 부상과 중국의 퇴역군인사업부장의 참석은 이번 회담에서 도시산업과 군 관련 교류를 협의했음을 짐작케 한다. 앞서 박 총리는 베이징 궤도교통지휘중심(도시철도관제센터)을 방문해 도시철도 건설 현황을 살폈다. 페이진자 퇴역군인사업부장이 배석한 것에 대해 통일부 당국자는 이날 “시 주석이 지난달 방북해 중국인민지원군 열사 기념시설 공동 운영, 관리와 이를 활용한 혁명전통교육·청소년 사상교육 등을 언급했는데, 이와 관련한 것일 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Chairman Wang began his schedule on the 15th at Pyongyang International Airport, welcomed by Kim Hyong-sik, vice chairman of the Supreme People's Assembly Presidium; Mun Song-hyok, deputy director of the Workers' Party; and Kim Myong-su, vice minister of Foreign Affairs. He visited the Friendship Tower, which honors Chinese People's Volunteer Army soldiers who died in North Korea during the Korean War, and laid a wreath. (왕 주석은 지난 15일 평양국제공항에서 김형식 최고인민회의 상임위원회 부위원장과 문성혁 노동당 부부장, 김명수 외무성 부상의 환영을 받으며 일정을 시작했다. 그는 6·25 전쟁 때 북한에서 전사한 중국인민지원군을 기리는 우의탑을 찾아 헌화했다.)

There is also a possibility that Chairman Wang may meet with Chairman Kim Jong-un during his visit to North Korea. Premier Pak met with President Xi on the first day of his visit to China, the 10th. (왕 주석이 방북 기간 김정은 위원장과 면담할 가능성도 있다. 박 총리는 방중 첫날인 지난 10일 시 주석과 면담했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Presidential Office: "President Lee Has Never Wavered on Prosecution Reform of Separating Investigation and Indictment" (청와대 “이 대통령, 수사·기소 분리 검찰개혁 한 번도 흔들린 적 없다”)
item.description:
On the 16th, the Presidential Office stated, "The Presidential Office and President Lee Jae-myung have never wavered on the core value of prosecution reform, which is the separation of investigation and indictment." (청와대가 16일 “청와대와 이재명 대통령은 수사·기소 분리라는 검찰개혁의 핵심 가치에 대해서 한번도 흔들린 적이 없다”라고 밝혔다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jeong said in a briefing that day regarding remarks made by writer Yoo Si-min on the YouTube show 'Maebul Show' on the 15th, "We do not have a separate stance or response regarding specific individuals' remarks," adding this. In that broadcast, Yoo claimed, "The reason prosecution reform hasn't been achieved for over a year is because the president does not want a complete separation of investigation and indictment." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 브리핑에서 유시민 작가가 15일 유튜브 방송 ‘매불쇼’에 나와 한 발언과 관련해 “특정인의 발언에 대해 별도 입장을 가지거나 별도 대응하지 않는다”며 이렇게 말했다. 유 작가는 해당 방송에서 “검찰 개혁이 1년이 넘도록 안 이뤄지는 이유는 대통령이 수사·기소 완전 분리를 원하지 않기 때문”이라고 주장했다.)

Furthermore, regarding People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk's allegations that President Lee played golf when a Navy soldier went missing, claiming it was "grounds for impeachment," Spokesperson Kang said, "It is difficult to confirm the president's private schedule. Therefore, we have no particular stance." (또, 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 이 대통령이 해군 병사 실종 당시 골프를 쳤다는 의혹을 제기하며 “탄핵감”이라고 주장한 것에 대해 강 대변인은 “대통령의 비공개 일정 확인은 어렵다. 따라서 특별한 입장은 없다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: “Even if embarrassed... Cannot tolerate agency heads who don’t know their own work” (이 대통령 “망신당해도…자기 일 모르는 기관장, 용납 못 해”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 16th, “There are still agency heads who don’t know what they’re doing,” adding, “If they fail to grasp even the basic outline of the most important tasks of their agency, I cannot tolerate that at all.” (이재명 대통령이 16일 “아직도 자기가 하고 있는 일이 뭔지 모르는 기관장이 있다”며 “그 기관의 가장 중요한 업무인 기본적인 개요조차 파악하지 못할 경우 절대로 용납할 수 없다”고 말했다.)

On the second day of the work reports, President Lee stated, “Yesterday, I saw that despite being pointed out during the previous work reports and even being embarrassed in front of people, there are still agency heads who don’t know what they’re doing. That is unacceptable.” (이 대통령은 업무보고 이틀 차인 이날 “어제 보니까 저번에 업무보고할 때 지적하고, 사람들한테 망신도 당했음에도 불구하고 아직도 자기가 하는 일이 뭔지 모르는 기관장이 있다. 있을 수 없는 일”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee continued, “Going forward, I am issuing a warning in advance: if anyone is still like that during the work reports, even if they have to stay up all night, they should at least grasp their own duties. This is tax money that the people work hard to pay. How can they enjoy all the benefits from it while showing not even the slightest interest in the affairs entrusted by the law and the people?” (이 대통령은 그러면서 “앞으로 업무보고할 때 지금까지도 혹시 그러고 있으면 밤새워서라도 자기 업무를 최소한 파악하라고 제가 미리 경고 말씀을 드린다”며 “국민들이 열심히 일해서 내는 세금인데 그걸로 누릴 거 다 누리면서 법률과 국민이 위임한 사무에 대해 최소한의 관심도 없이 그러면 되겠냐”고 말했다.)

President Lee also said, “One hour of a public official’s time is worth 52 million hours of the people’s time. I thought, ‘Isn’t this a failure to properly recognize how important this is?’ I believe there will be no such people from now on.” (이 대통령은 또 “공직자의 한 시간은 국민 5200만 시간의 가치가 있다. 얼마나 중요한 일인데 그 엄중함을 제대로 인식하지 못한 것 아닌가 하는 생각이 들었다. 앞으로 그런 사람은 없을 거로 믿는다”라고 말했다.)

item.title: Kwon Seong-dong's 'Farewell Banner' Lacks 'Words of Apology'…Criticized as "The Height of Arrogance" (‘사죄의 말’ 빠진 권성동 ‘이별 펼침막’…“오만함의 극치” 비판)
item.description:
On the 16th, Kwon Seong-dong, a lawmaker from the People Power Party who lost his seat after being sentenced to two years in prison on charges of receiving 100 million won in illegal political funds from the Unification Church, hung banners in his district of Gangneung, Gangwon Province, reading "I love you. Thank you." (16일 통일교 쪽으로부터 불법 정치자금 1억원을 수수한 혐의로 징역 2년형이 확정돼 의원직을 상실한 권성동 국민의힘 의원이 지역구인 강원도 강릉시에 “사랑합니다. 감사합니다”라는 내용의 현수막을 내걸었다.)

An associate of lawmaker Kwon said in a phone call with *The Hankyoreh* on the same day, "(We) put them up yesterday (the 15th) as a gesture of gratitude (to Gangneung citizens)," adding, "Whether the (Supreme Court) ruling went well or poorly, we had to greet (the citizens), so we put them up as a greeting." It was reported that about 40 banners bearing Kwon's name and reading "Dear citizens of Gangneung, I love you. Thank you" were installed throughout the city. (권 의원 쪽 관계자는 이날 한겨레와 한 통화에서 “(강릉 시민들에게) 감사 인사차 어제(15일) 붙였다”며 “(대법원 판결이) 잘 돼도 그렇고, 잘못돼도 그렇고 (시민들에게) 인사는 해야 하니, 인사 차원으로 붙인 것”이라고 말했다. “강릉시민 여러분, 사랑합니다. 감사합니다”라고 권 의원 명의로 적힌 현수막은 시내 곳곳에 40여개가 설치됐다고 한다.)

Kwon, a five-term lawmaker, had been elected consecutively five times in the district since entering the National Assembly as a member of the 18th Assembly in 2009. (5선인 권 의원은 2009년 18대 국회의원으로 국회에 입성한 뒤 해당 지역구에서 다섯 번 내리 당선된 바 있다.)

Criticism emerged from political circles, calling it "the height of arrogance" as the banners lacked an apology for the finalized guilty verdict. Lim Myeong-hee, a spokesperson for the Rebuilding Korea Party, urged on Facebook that day, "Is an apology that hard?" and "Offer a sincere apology to the citizens of Gangneung and the people of Korea." (정치권에서는 현수막에 유죄 확정에 대한 사과가 빠졌다며 “오만함의 극치”라는 비판이 나왔다. 임명희 조국혁신당 대변인은 이날 페이스북을 통해 “사과가 그렇게 어렵나”라며 “강릉 시민과 국민 앞에 진심으로 사죄하라”고 촉구했다.)

Spokesperson Lim criticized, "This incident is not simply a matter of one lawmaker's illegal act," and "It is a 'black connection between power and a pseudo-religion' that undermines democratic values and violates the constitutional principle of separation of church and state, and it is a serious crime that disrupts social order by seeking political influence through monetary bribery as a medium." (임 대변인은 “이번 사태는 단순히 국회의원 한 명의 불법 행위로 끝날 일이 아니”라며 “민주주의의 가치를 훼손하고 정교분리 원칙의 헌법을 위반한 ‘권력과 사이비 종교의 검은 커넥션’이자 금품 로비를 매개로 정치 세력화를 도모하며 사회 질서를 어지럽힌 중대 범죄”라고 비판했다.)

Spokesperson Lim stated, "The social and political responsibilities go beyond legal punishment and are by no means light," and "The People Power Party, which shows no remorse for this, should apologize to the people." She added, "Lawmaker Kwon had not a single word of apology or remorse until the very last moment," and "It is the height of arrogance, having only used the support from Gangneung citizens to inflate his own political position and wealth." (임 대변인은 “법적 처벌을 넘어 사회적·정치적 책임이 결코 가볍지 않다”며 “이에 대한 어떠한 반성도 없는 국민의힘은 국민 앞에 사죄하라”고 했다. 이어 “권 의원은 마지막 순간까지 단 한마디의 사과도, 반성도 없었다”며 “강릉 시민들이 보내준 지지를 자신의 정치적 입지와 배를 불리는 데만 이용해 온 오만함의 극치”라고 덧붙였다.)

On the same day, the Supreme Court's second division (presiding Justice Eom Sang-pil) upheld the lower court's sentence of two years in prison and a fine of 100 million won for lawmaker Kwon, who was charged with violating the Political Funds Act for promising to 'support the Unification Church' and receiving 100 million won from the church during the 20th presidential election, in which former President Yoon Suk Yeol ran. According to the Public Official Election Act and the National Assembly Act, which stipulate that a sitting lawmaker sentenced to prison is stripped of the right to vote and hold office, Kwon lost his seat with this ruling. (이날 대법원 2부(주심 엄상필 대법관)는 윤석열 전 대통령이 출마했던 20대 대선 당시 ‘통일교를 지원해 주겠다’고 약속하고 통일교 쪽으로부터 1억원을 수수한 혐의(정치자금법 위반)를 받는 권 의원에게 징역 2년과 추징금 1억원을 선고한 원심 판결을 확정했다. 현직 의원이 형사사건에서 실형을 선고받으면 피선거권과 의원직을 박탈한다는 내용의 공직선거법 및 국회법 규정에 따라 이날 판결로 권 의원은 의원직을 잃게 됐다.)

Kwon released a statement on the same day, saying, "I cannot hide deep regret over the factual judgment and legal application. However, I will humbly accept the final judgment of the judiciary." He also stated, "I now step down from public office. But my feelings for the people, Gangneung, and the People Power Party will not change in the future," and "I will cherish the love and grace I received from the citizens of Gangneung in my heart forever. Thank you." (권 의원은 이날 입장문을 내어 “사실 판단과 법리 적용에 대해 깊은 아쉬움을 감출 수 없다. 그러나 사법부의 최종 판단을 겸허히 받아들이겠다”고 밝혔다. 또 “저는 이제 공직에서 물러난다. 그러나 국민과 강릉, 그리고 국민의힘을 향한 제 마음은 앞으로도 변하지 않을 것”이라며 “강릉 시민 여러분께 받은 사랑과 은혜를 평생 가슴에 간직하겠다. 감사하다”고도 했다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Presidential Office Dismisses Yoo Si-min's Claim of Presidential Responsibility for Prosecution Reform... Jeong Cheong-rae Says "No Comment" (청와대, 유시민 ‘검찰개혁 대통령 책임론’ 일축…정청래 “노코멘트”)
item.description:
The Presidential Office has dismissed author Yoo Si-min's claim of presidential responsibility for prosecution reform, stating, "The Presidential Office and President Lee Jae-myung have never wavered on the core value of prosecution reform, which is the separation of investigation and indictment." <<> Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung said on the 16th, "We do not hold a separate position or respond separately to the remarks of a specific individual." Yoo sparked controversy on the 15th during the YouTube broadcast "Maebul Show," where he argued, "The reason prosecution reform has not been realized for over a year is because the President does not want the complete separation of investigation and indictment," adding, "I believe President Lee's choice will end in failure." <<> Criticism also poured in from among the candidates for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea. Former lawmaker Kim Min-seok said in an interview with SBS on the same day, "It seems to have gone beyond the realm of typical commentary," adding, "In the past, Yoo has said that President Kim Dae-jung would fail, but that did not happen." Lawmaker Song Young-gil told reporters, "Expressing it in such a way of curses and malicious talk seems a bit inappropriate." Lawmaker Ko Min-jung criticized, "Trying to classify everything right and wrong is actually the path to certain failure." <<> In contrast, former representative Jeong Cheong-rae said, "I will say no comment," adding, "Prosecution reform is the identity of the Democratic Party, and it is the banner and symbol of the party's reform." <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (청와대가 유시민 작가의 ‘검찰개혁 대통령 책임론’과 관련해 “청와대와 이재명 대통령은 수사·기소 분리라는 검찰개혁의 핵심 가치에 대해서 한번도 흔들린 적이 없다”고 일축했다.)

item.title: NSC Standing Committee Reviews Korea-U.S. Trade Issues, Including Coupang; Economic Ministries Also Attend (NSC 상임위, 쿠팡 등 한미 통상 현안 점검…경제부처도 참석)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae's National Security Office held the "National Security Council (NSC) Standing Committee" meeting on the 16th, chaired by National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac, to discuss pending issues in Korea-U.S. trade and security sectors. (청와대 국가안보실이 16일 위성락 국가안보실장 주재로 한미 통상·안보 분야 현안과 관련한 ‘국가안전보장회의(NSC) 상임위원회’를 개최했다.)

Director Wi stated during the meeting, "The more uncertainty rises in the external environment, the better we need to coordinate responses based on shared understanding to protect national interests," adding, "As Korea-U.S. relations combine trade and security, multiple ministries must work in organic cooperation to advance them to the next level." In addition to the existing NSC Standing Committee members, officials from the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, and the Fair Trade Commission also attended the meeting. (위 실장은 이날 회의에서 “대외 환경의 불확실성이 고조되는 시기일수록 공통된 인식을 바탕으로 국익을 지키기 위한 대처방안을 잘 조정해야 한다”며 “한미관계는 통상과 안보가 결합된 만큼 한 단계 진전시키기 위해 여러 부처가 유기적으로 협력하여 대응해야 한다”고 말했다. 회의에는 기존 국가안전보장회의 상임위원회 구성 위원에 더해 재정경제부, 산업통상부, 공정거래위원회 관계자들도 참석했다.)

Kang Kyung-wha, South Korea's Ambassador to the U.S., who temporarily returned from the United States the previous day, also participated in the meeting. Given that Ambassador Kang remarked the day before regarding the Coupang issue, "It's an issue that will last much longer than I initially thought," it appears that the meeting discussed Korea-U.S. trade issues, including the Coupang matter. Ambassador Kang stated, "While managing that issue separately, we continue discussions at various levels to make progress on the items agreed upon by the two leaders in the joint fact sheet." (전날 미국에서 일시 귀국한 강경화 주미한국대사도 이날 회의에 참석했다. 강 대사가 전날 쿠팡 문제와 관련해 “제가 생각했던 것보다는 훨씬 오래 가는 이슈”라고 말한 만큼 회의에서는 쿠팡 문제를 포함한 한미 통상 현안이 논의된 것으로 보인다. 강 대사는 “그 이슈는 그 이슈대로 관리하면서 조인트 팩트시트에 양 정상께서 합의한 사안들에 대해 진전을 만들려고 다양한 레벨에서 협의를 계속하고 있다”고 말했다.)

The National Security Office announced, "Going forward, in line with the trend where trade issues and security agendas are closely linked, we plan to coordinate security strategies through ongoing cooperation among relevant ministries in a direction that maximizes national interests." (국가안보실은 “앞으로도 통상 현안과 안보 의제가 긴밀히 연계되는 흐름에 맞춰, 관련 부처 간 상시적인 공조를 통해 국익을 극대화되는 방향으로 안보 전략을 조율해 갈 방침”이라고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, regarding U.S. President Donald Trump's statement on the 15th (local time) that he would "look at some companies coming from South Korea and other regions" to boost U.S. naval power, Cheong Wa Dae said, "Given the mutual understanding between the two leaders on reciprocal cooperation in the shipbuilding sector, we hope to continue concretizing cooperation measures through bilateral consultations." A Cheong Wa Dae official added, "Based on the shared recognition of the importance of shipbuilding cooperation in developing the future-oriented, comprehensive strategic alliance of the Korea-U.S. alliance, we are exploring ways to enhance cooperation in shipbuilding-related fields." (한편 청와대는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 15일(현지시각) 미군의 해군력 증강을 위해 “한국과 다른 지역에서 오는 기업들 몇몇을 살펴보게 될 것”이라고 말한 데 대해 “조선 분야의 호혜적 협력에 대한 양국 정상의 공감대가 있는 만큼 앞으로도 양국 간 협의를 통해 협력 방안을 구체화해 나갈 수 있기를 기대한다”고 밝혔다. 청와대 관계자는 “한미는 한미동맹의 미래형 포괄적 전략동맹의 발전에 있어 조선 협력이 중요하다는 공감대를 토대로 조선 관련 분야에서 협력 증진 방안을 모색 중”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Warns Agency Heads to "Grasp Your Work Even If You Have to Stay Up All Night" (이 대통령, 기관장들에 “밤새워서라도 업무 파악하라” 경고)
item.description:
On the second day of ministry briefings, President Lee Jae-myung on the 16th said, "There are still agency heads who don't know what they're doing. That's unacceptable," as he moved to tighten discipline in the public service. (이재명 대통령이 부처 업무보고 이틀째인 16일 “아직도 자기가 하고 있는 일이 뭔지 모르는 기관장이 있다. 있을 수 없는 일”이라며 공직사회 기강 다잡기에 나섰다.)

During closing remarks at the briefing for the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission, and the Personal Information Protection Commission held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, President Lee stated, "I'm giving you a preemptive warning—grasp your own duties, even if you have to stay up all night." This appears aimed at instilling a sense of urgency in the public service with the first briefing of his second year in office. President Lee added, "If you fail to grasp even the basic outline of the most important tasks of your agency, it will never be tolerated. How can you enjoy all the perks paid for by taxpayers' money and still act like that?" (이 대통령은 이날 오전 청와대 영빈관에서 주재한 과학기술정보통신부·방송미디어통신위원회·개인정보보호위원회 업무보고 마무리발언에서 “밤을 새워서라도 자기 업무를 최소한 파악하라고 제가 미리 경고 말씀을 드린다”며 이렇게 말했다. 집권 2년차 첫 업무보고를 계기로 공직사회에 긴장감을 불어넣으려는 의도로 보인다. 이 대통령은 “그 기관의 가장 중요한 업무인 기본적인 개요조차 파악하지 못할 경우 절대로 용납할 수 없다”며 “국민 세금으로 누릴 건 다 누리면서 어떻게 그럴 수가 있느냐”고 말했다.)

President Lee also asked citizens' opinions online in real time on issues like "regulating social media for teenagers" and "pet medical care in the public sector." During the Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission briefing, he said, "In countries like Australia and the UK, there are laws regulating social media for those under 16. Press 1 if you agree with blocking social media access for those under 16, and press 2 if you disagree." When anti-rights commissioner Ban Sang-kwon, a spokesperson for the commission, reported on the collected comments, saying, "The overwhelming number is for option 1, though it might be because teenagers find it hard to express opinions in the comment section at this time," laughter broke out in the room. During the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs briefing, he proposed, "Press 1 if you support public sector animal medical care, and press 2 if you oppose it—this could help inform policy decisions." (이 대통령은 ‘청소년 에스엔에스(SNS) 규제’ ‘공공 영역에서 반려견 진료’ 등에 대한 시민 의견을 온라인을 통해 즉석에서 묻기도 했다. 이 대통령은 방송미디어통신위원회 업무보고 중 “호주(오스트레일리아), 영국 등에서는 16세 이하 에스엔에스를 규제하는 나라가 있다. 16세 이하의 에스엔에스 접근 차단에 동의하면 1번, 동의 안 하면 2번을 눌러보라”고 했다. 반상권 방미통위 대변인이 댓글을 취합한 결과에 대해 “1번이 압도적으로 많은 상황”이라면서도 “다만 시간대상 청소년들이 댓글창에 의견을 표시하기가 힘들어서 그럴 수 있다”고 말하자 현장에서 웃음이 나오기도 했다. 농림축산식품부 보고에서는 “공공영역에서 동물을 진료하는 것에 대한 찬성은 1번, 반대는 2번을 눌러주면 정책 판단에 참고가 될 것 같다”고 제안하기도 했다.)

President Lee also strongly rebutted speculation about "Jeonbuk being sidelined" following the announcement of a semiconductor cluster investment plan in the Gwangju-Jeonnam region. Regarding Hyundai Motor Group's approximately 9 trillion won investment in Saemangeum, he remarked, "This is a massive scale," and criticized, "It's truly problematic for responsible people to make strange noises about this." (이 대통령은 전남광주 지역의 반도체 클러스터 투자 계획 발표와 맞물려 일각에서 ‘전북 소외론’이 나오는 것에 대해서도 이날 강하게 반박했다. 이 대통령은 약 9조원 규모의 현대차그룹 새만금 투자와 관련 “엄청난 규모”라며 “책임있는 사람들이 여기에 이상한 소리를 하는 건 정말 문제”라고 꼬집었다.)

item.title: President Lee on Coupang's Penalty: "Not Targeted, Followed the Law and Policy" (이 대통령, 쿠팡 과징금에 “표적 아니다, 법과 방침 따른 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 16th regarding the government's increased penalties for personal information leaks that it was "done according to the law and policy without considering the characteristics of the company at all." This is interpreted as a remark concerning Coupang, which was fined 624.6 billion won for a personal information leak. (이재명 대통령이 16일 정부의 개인정보 유출 제재 과징금 강화에 관해 “기업 특성을 전혀 고려하지 않고 법과 방침에 따라 한 것”이라고 말했다. 개인정보 유출로 6246억원의 과징금을 부과받은 쿠팡에 대한 발언으로 풀이된다.)

During a briefing with the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Korea Communications Commission, and the Personal Information Protection Commission held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House, President Lee said, "Recently, the amount of fines has increased somewhat, and some companies are claiming, 'Isn't this targeting me alone?' The policy of the Republic of Korea is to strengthen sanctions." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대 영빈관에서 주재한 과학기술정보통신부·방송통신위원회·개인정보보호위원회 업무보고에서 “최근 과징금 액수가 좀 올라갔는데, 여기에 대해 ‘나만 표적으로 해서 이런 거 아니냐’고 주장하는 기업이 있다. 대한민국 정부 방침은 제재를 강화한다는 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

Coupang was fined a record 624.681 billion won last month by the Personal Information Protection Commission for a personal information leak. In response, the U.S. House Judiciary Committee released an investigative report on the 1st (local time) claiming that the South Korean government had discriminately attacked U.S.-owned companies like Coupang. (쿠팡은 개인정보 유출로 지난달 개인정보보호위원회로부터 역대 최고 규모인 6246억8100만원의 과징금을 부과받았다. 이에 미국 하원 법사위원회는 지난 1일(현지시각) 한국 정부가 쿠팡 등 미국 소유 기업을 차별적으로 공격했다고 주장하는 조사보고서를 냈다.)

President Lee added, "In the area of personal information protection, relevant companies show less interest, and if a leak occurs, they think patching it up cheaply costs less than security expenses. This has led to neglect and repeated incidents, culminating in large-scale information leaks. According to our established policy, we must significantly raise penalty amounts for leaks or misuse to far exceed the costs of personal information protection, so that actual protective activities are carried out." (이 대통령은 “개인정보 보호 부분은 관련 기업들이 관심이 떨어지고, 유출되어 봐야 적당하게 때우는 게 보안 비용보다 적게 드니까 사실상 방치하다 사고가 계속 발생하다가 대규모 정보 유출 사고 발생한다”며 “우리가 정한 방침대로 유출이나 악용에 대해 제재금을 대규모로 대폭 올려서 개인정보 보호 비용을 훨씬 초과하게 만들어야 실제 보호활동을 할 거 아니냐”고 덧붙였다.)

In response, Personal Information Protection Commission Chairman Song Kyung-hee said, "The PIPC focuses on violations of the law and imposes strict and fair penalties on any country or company. We are also reviewing a policy of adding 30% to fines if an incident of personal information breach is concealed or destroyed, if discovered later." (이에 송경희 개인정보보호위원장은 “개보위는 법 위반 행위에 집중해 어느 국가나 기업이나 엄정하고 공정하게 처분하고 있다”며 “개인정보 침해 사고를 은닉하거나 폐기하는 행위가 나중에 적발되면 과징금을 30% 추가하는 방향도 검토하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Coupang released a statement on the same day regarding the controversy over Coupang Inc. (Coupang's U.S. entity) lobbying the U.S. government and political circles, saying, "Lobbying activities toward the U.S. government and political circles are activities guaranteed by the U.S. Constitution and are the rights of responsible citizens in American society." (한편, 쿠팡은 이날 입장문을 내어 쿠팡아이엔씨(Inc·쿠팡 미국 법인)가 미국 정부와 정치권을 상대로 로비를 벌였다는 논란에 대해 “미국 정부와 정치권에 대한 로비 활동은 미국 헌법에 보장된 활동이고, 미국 사회에서 책임감 있는 시민의 권리”라고 말했다.)

Reported by Seo Young-ji, Yoo Young-jae, and Lee Ju-bin at yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 유영재 이주빈 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party’s ‘Supplementary Investigative Power Conflict’ Spreads… Hardline Members Send ‘Text Bombs’ (민주 ‘보완수사권 갈등’ 확산…강성 당원들 ‘문자 폭탄’)
item.description:
The internal debate within the Democratic Party of Korea is intensifying over whether to ‘completely abolish’ or ‘allow exceptions to’ the prosecution’s supplementary investigative powers. Lawmakers advocating for the complete abolition held a forum on the 16th to strongly refute claims within the party that some supplementary investigative powers should be retained. (검사의 보완수사권 ‘전면 폐지’와 ‘예외적 허용’을 두고 더불어민주당 내부 논쟁이 격화하고 있다. 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 주장하는 의원들은 16일 토론회를 열어 당내 보완수사권 일부 존치 주장을 강하게 반박했다.)

Jeong Cheong-rae, a former party leader and candidate for the party’s top post, hosted the ‘Forum on Criminal Procedure Law Revision Based on Cases of Prosecutorial Power Abuse’ at the National Assembly on the same day. He stated, “Prosecution reform is not only the flag and symbol of the Democratic Party but also of the democratic and progressive camp,” and emphasized, “Supplementary investigative powers must be completely abolished, and various issues should be resolved through other methods.” This was a direct rebuttal to the cautious stance within the party, which argues that ‘supplementary investigative powers should be exceptionally maintained for crimes targeting the socially vulnerable’ or that ‘the side effects of completely abolishing such powers must be considered.’ <<> The forum was co-hosted by former leader Jeong, along with Seo Young-kyo, chair of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and lawmakers Kim Yong-min, Lee Seong-yoon, and Choi Min-hee. Addressing recent internal disagreements, lawmaker Kim Yong-min remarked, “The prosecution dismantled the constitutional order and degenerated into an anti-constitutional state agency, leading to the abolition of the prosecution service. That was the starting point for prosecution reform, yet now there seems to be confusion again.” <<> The internal conflict over supplementary investigative powers is also spreading among party members and supporters. Hardline members and supporters, who have strongly demanded prosecution reform, are fiercely criticizing lawmakers who have advocated a cautious approach. Park Ji-won, a five-term Democratic Party lawmaker, said in a KBS radio interview on the same day, “After changing my stance (on supplementary investigative powers), I received a flood of calls and text bombs from our hardline supporters.” <<> On the same day, eight Democratic Party member groups held a press conference at the National Assembly. They called out the names of 11 lawmakers, including Hong Ki-won and Kim Nam-hee, who had signed the revision bill to ‘maintain exceptional supplementary investigative powers’ proposed on the 14th, asking, “Do you take party members for fools?” They also pressured the party leadership by asking, “We ask acting party leader Han Byung-do: What is the reason for placing those who advocate for retaining supplementary investigative powers at the forefront of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee?” <<> Kim Chae-woon Reporter cwk@hani.co.kr Ko Kyung-joo Reporter goh@hani.co.kr (당권 주자인 정청래 전 대표는 이날 국회에서 ‘검사 권력 오남용 사례로 본 형사소송법 개정 토론회’를 주최하고 “검찰 개혁은 민주당뿐만 아니라 민주·진보 진영의 깃발이고 상징”이라며 “보완수사권은 전면 폐지하고 다른 방법으로 여러 가지 문제를 해결해야 한다”고 밝혔다. ‘사회적 약자 대상 범죄 등에 예외적으로 보완수사권을 유지해야 한다’거나, ‘보완수사권 전면 폐지 부작용을 고려해야 한다’는 당내 신중론을 정면 반박한 것이다.)
